## What?

The future is directing towards "Forward Deployed" everything. 

This was coined by the Palantir in it's role, "Forward Deployed Engineer". Despite not having a software of their own for several years, sheer proximity to the problem allowed them to create exceptional value.

I'm not the first one to notice[^most-expensive-wall], and I'm sure I won't be the last.

## Why is it such a powerful idea? 

An FDE's ability to craft solutions is tied to their *implicit* understanding of the problem as much as their explicit understanding.

## It's implication?

- The marine's will perpetually write about their "tooth-to-tail" ratio
- You can't outsource science or art, only its execution
